climate_pressure: Extreme winds associated with Cyclone Gezani in February 2026.
documented_impact: Housing and service damage displaced people into temporary sites.
fcv_mediator: Crowding and limited services in displacement sites weakened children's protective environment.
possible_consequence: UNICEF reports heightened risks of violence and exploitation, not measured post-cyclone incident rates.
alternative_explanations: Pre-existing inequalities, household resources and service quality also influence protection risk.
Agency reporting is not an incident-based causal evaluation.
uncertainty: This is a source-stated post-disaster protection-risk mechanism, not proof of increased violence incidence, anthropogenic attribution of the cyclone, or a national FCV classification.
resilience_factors: Accessible shelters, privacy, lighting, sanitation and functioning protection referrals can address the reported risk factors; effectiveness is not evaluated.
compact_statement: Post-Gezani displacement-site crowding and limited services heightened child violence/exploitation risk; incidence changes were not measured.
